title: Keeping Order Among Liars — Four Legislators in the Tholos Though One May Lie
description: The Castro and Liskov protocol: four legislators chosen by lot in the Tholos of Schedia, one who may lie, messengers across the stone floor, and a law scroll whose lines must stand in the same order in every honest copy.
question: Can a replicated service keep its commands in order when some of its machines lie, the leader included, and messages take arbitrarily long?
how: We find out by exploring how four legislators drawn by lot in the Tholos held one scroll of their law when any of them, the writer included, might be lying.
